}}'''Desandre Alraed''' is a [[Ghealdan|Ghealdanin]] [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Yellow Ajah]].

==Appearance==
She is willowy, with brown hair and large brown eyes. She wears her Great Serpent ring on her right hand.{{ref/book|9|p}}

== Strength and Abilities ==
Desandre is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|strong]] in the [[One Power]], with a strength level of {{opsl|21}}.{{ref/book|twotc|Desandre|comp}} She is the strongest among the fifty-one Aes Sedai captured at the [[Black Tower]], with only [[Lemai]] being as strong.{{ref/book|9|p}}

==History==
She spent six years as [[novice]] and seven as [[Accepted]]. 

She was an [[Accepted]] in the [[White Tower]] during the [[Aiel War]] when the [[Dragon]] was reborn, she was sent out of the White Tower to collect the names of newborn children for the bounty.{{ref/book|0|4}}

==Activities==
She sides with [[Elaida's White Tower]] after the coup.

She is one of fifty-one sisters that took part in the [[attack on the Black Tower]].{{ref/book|7|p}}

Elaida abandons the Aes Sedai sent to capture the Black Tower, including Desandre, at [[Alviarin]]'s suggestion. {{ref/book|7|32}}

They were all captured and bonded involuntarily by the [[Asha'man]]. To whom Desandre was bonded is unknown.{{ref/book|8|26}}

[[Gabrelle]] convinces Toveine that they must publicly submit themselves to Lemai and Desandre, the two sisters who stand the highest among the captured Aes Sedai; Gabrelle says this is necessary to ensure that the captured Aes Sedai remain united.{{ref/book|9|p}}

She and Lemai become the leaders of the captive Aes Sedai, although Lemai is "second" to her due to spending longer as Accepted.{{ref|{{twotc}}, Lemai Ambani}} They issue orders that all Aes Sedai must achieve cordial relations with their [[Asha'man]] captors. According to [[Toveine Gazal]], this is simply a ploy to lull the men into becoming amenable to them.{{ref/book|10|p}}

Toveine dislikes taking any orders from them.{{ref/book|10|p}}

As most Aes Sedai in this group it can be guessed that also Desandre was Turned to the Shadow along her Asha'man.
